takeaway: NQ closed strong Tue: Nasdaq +1.18% to 26,478, S&P +0.60% to 7,723 (1.2% from ATH) on a 3rd day of chip leadership (AVGO, AMD, MU) and the Anthropic/AI bid. WTI settled $99.90 (-1.8%), Brent $113.88, VIX 17.5, but the 10Y is still pinned at 4.995%. After hours the semis/AI-adjacent prints sold off: NXPI -7.6%, TER ~-6.6%, STX -5/-6% (beat-and-raise, priced in), HOOD -7% on a miss, V -1%. Expect a softer semis open Wed; FOMC 2:00 PM (hold expected) with Warsh at 2:30, then MSFT/GOOGL/NOW/KLAC after the bell.
